description: This file defines a utility function `parseJsonSafe` for safely parsing JSON strings with fallback, and it also exports a function `getEnvConfig` that retrieves environment configuration variables related to API endpoints, feature flags, and environment settings for a React-based application.

methods.name: parseJsonSafe
methods.description: A utility function that attempts to parse a JSON string safely, returning a fallback value if parsing fails or the input is falsy.

methods.name: getEnvConfig()
methods.description: A function that constructs and returns a configuration object derived from environment variables, including API base URLs, WebSocket URLs, environment modes, and feature flags.
